primitives.name: Exposed minus sign
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No uppercase, no mono, no 0.16em tracking.** | Exo 2 is retired.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a requirement to distinguish the binary subtraction operator from the unary negation indicator.

layer2.telemetry: Error rate in parsing mathematical expressions embedded in UI text after glyph substitution.
